title: Where It Belongs
description: Puts all items from your inventory to nearby chests and barrels with the click of a button!
body:
# Put your things where they belong!

> Puts all items from your inventory to nearby chests and barrels with the click of a button!

> You can bind this action to any key you like!

![button showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71c7aa6ece2abe3404b71bf87ab1ec6fc0748f3c_0.webp)

# Commands configuration
- ```/whereitbelongs radius <value>``` to change the active radius, where if ```value = 1```, then it means you have to stand on the storage block itself in order for this to work.
- ```/whereitbelongs los <bool>``` to turn _LOS Check_ **_on_** or **_off_**, ```true``` or ```false``` respectively
